title: Builder BLD-304: View as

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-304.

detail:
B3 Lenses, pass BLD-304 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-304). View as. Scope: components/builder/view-as. Build: Visitor, member and host previews using the existing viewer gates. Done when: Host-only blocks are absent in the visitor preview. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-108. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

View as (components/builder/view-as, lib/builder/view-as.ts): Host, Member, Visitor in the top bar as one kit segmented control (the three actions in the command bar; the eye button is Visitor, Esc is Host again). The host sees the editing canvas with placeholders, tags and sample copy. A visitor or a member sees the page in preview through the renderers' existing gates: puck.isEditing off, tags off, a live role's sample copy with no Space rows left out (roles.tsx emptyLive, exposed as roleDrawsNothingForVisitor), an unknown block type left out; what the view never meets is listed under the canvas with the reason and stays in the document. A member is a signed-in visitor: the same page today, with metadata.viewer { signedIn, member } as the seam for a block that wants to read it (no website block does yet). Test: host-only sections are absent in the visitor and member previews and present for the host; a live role with real rows is not host-only; over the kit corpus on a live Space with no rows every authored section stays.
